liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Turn On Your Lovelight/** (3 reviews): Pigpen is described as very energetic, with a basic early jam; Reviewer praises the jamming despite a cut in the recording [5][14][15]
- **The Other One** (3 reviews): The reviewer says it is among the early versions with the story about getting busted for smiling on a sunny day; Reviewer counts it among favorite versions and likes Bobby's original lyrics [5][8][16]
- **Cold Rain And Snow** (2 reviews): Played fast, like the version on the first LP; Reviewer notes a really fast early version [12][14]
- **That's It For The Other One** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls it the best version of the song they have heard; Reviewer calls it the first-known performance of the suite; tentative in spots, with Bobby's early lyrics [9][14]
- **It Hurts Me Too** (1 review): Shows a bluesy, more authentic side of Jerry [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1967-10-22.116228.sbd.kaplan.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 9 songs; 55 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1967-10-22.sbd.yerys.1525.shnf**: soundboard; 9 songs; 54 min; rated 4.2/5 by 10 [2]
- **gd67-10-22.sbd.miller.18101.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 7 songs; 45 min; rated 4.2/5 by 40 [4]. Said about its sound: There is a sound problem at the start of the recording, but the rest is fine; Sound quality is judged very good for 1967; Sound quality has highs and lows across the show [4][11][13][15]
- **gd1967-10-22.sbd.miller.116257.flac16**: soundboard; 7 songs; 55 min; rated 4.85/5 by 13 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer links the lyric to Bobby dropping a water balloon on a cop from a third floor, after the month's pot bust at 710 [5]
- Reviewer says it was a benefit for the bust, with Quicksilver and Big Brother also on the bill [7]
- Reviewer says Jerry could not play the second set, so Big Brother played three sets; Owsley purple acid was around [7]
- Reviewer notes Mickey joined on 9/29/67, making this the earliest archive recording with him, though he can't hear him [16]
- Other artists on the bill were QMS and Big Brother & The Holding Company [1]
- The end of Lovelight is missing; the uploader asks for an audience tape to fill it [2]
- The reviewer prefers this visceral psychedelic material to mellow, wistful later songs like Black Peter and Wharf Rat [12]
- Uploader finds the earlier No Noise circulating shn muddy, and this copy much clearer [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1967-10-22.116228.sbd.kaplan.flac16**: transferred by Seth Kaplan; source: SBD > Master Reels > DAT; Lineage/Recording Info detail/Editing detail: SBD > Master Reels > DAT (Panasonic 3700) > Sound card (Delta DiO 2496) > PC hard drive… [1]. Also: Discs came from an anonymous source; Cool Edit and WavePad were used to normalize tracks and clean glitches; This source eliminates an analog cassette generation present in earlier copies [1]
- **gd1967-10-22.sbd.yerys.1525.shnf**: transferred by SHN Encode and Upload: Ben Yerys; source: SBDmR>Cass>DAT>Sonic Solutions via D. Gans>CDR [2]. Also: Seeded by Gans, so the uploader assumes this is all the vault holds of the show [2]
- **gd67-10-22.sbd.miller.18101.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Uploader used Samplitude to normalize and fix cuts; no noise reduction was applied [4]
- **gd1967-10-22.sbd.miller.116257.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat [3]
- Lineage given as soundboard to master reels to DAT, using a Panasonic deck [18]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1967-10-22 Winterland Arena, San Francisco, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1967-10-22-winterland-arena-san-francisco-ca-usa/) [23]
- Fan art by Mari Tepper: [Grateful Dead Big Brother Quicksilver Winterland 1967 AOR 2.205 Concert Poster](https://concertposterauction.com/Listing/Details/1368138/Grateful-Dead-Big-Brother-Quicksilver-Winterland-1967-AOR-2205-Concert-Poster) [24]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [current-page:url:arg:3 | Grateful Dead](https://www.dead.net/tags/winterland) [25]
